tasks.title: concurrent_run.py: write ALL project files matching tab contracts
implementation: Read .pi/skills/classifier-lab/scripts/concurrent_run.py
Read packages/ux-lab/src/components/sparta/explorer/ClassifierLabView.tsx to understand ALL tab data contracts
Update _write_ux_project() to write these files in create-classifier/projects/{id}/:
research.md — from dogpile output (phase_research already saves this)
research-gate.json — {passed:bool, hash?, lineCount?, memoryVerified?}
data.json — {path, modality, totalTrain, classCount, classes:[{name,train,val,test}], gatePassed, gateThreshold, minPerClass}
dataset.parquet — full training data via polars (already drafted)
tune-results.json — aggregate rounds from ALL backbones: {trials:[], strategy:'switchboard-concurrent', winningRound}
benchmark.json — {results:[{backbone,macro_f1,accuracy,wilson_score_lower,gate_passed}], selected_backbone, selected_metrics}
eval-results.json — winner's eval_details.json copied here: {model,macro_f1,accuracy,test_samples,holdout_passed,classes,confusion_matrix,per_class}
promote-results.json — {ready:bool, model, f1, hf_repo, exported:bool}
Read eval_details.json from winner's log_dir after training completes
Use pick_winner() results to populate all files

tasks.command:
cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/pi-mono/.pi/skills/classifier-lab &&
.venv/bin/python scripts/concurrent_run.py run \
  --task "news topic classification" \
  --dataset "ag_news" \
  --modality text \
  --backbones "prajjwal1/bert-tiny,distilbert-base-uncased" \
  --gate-f1 0.85 \
  --max-rounds 3 \
  --max-train-samples 2000 \
  --poll-interval 10.0

definition_of_done.command:
python3 -c "
import json
from pathlib import Path
proj = Path('/home/graham/workspace/experiments/pi-mono/.pi/skills/create-classifier/projects/news-topic-classification')
required = ['meta.json', 'data.json', 'benchmark.json', 'eval-results.json', 'tune-results.json', 'research-gate.json', 'dataset.parquet']
missing = [f for f in required if not (proj / f).exists()]
if missing:
    print(f'MISSING: {missing}')
else:
    eval_data = json.loads((proj / 'eval-results.json').read_text())
    print(f'ALL FILES PRESENT. Winner: {eval_data.get(\"model\",\"?\")} F1={eval_data.get(\"macro_f1\",0):.3f}')
"
definition_of_done.assertion: ALL FILES PRESENT with non-zero F1
